installation_lifecycle.decision: Accept actual clean install, exact reinstall, alpha.1 upgrade, rollback and uninstall in an isolated profile using final compiled package.
limitations: Scoped alpha: supplied pipe-only mechanical equipment or pipe accessories, rigid pipes, bounded equipment movement and physical joins in an owned standalone project. Exactly 13 admitted MEP actions; each delivered project still needs engineering and visual verification.
Ductwork, electrical, containment, calculations, arbitrary routing, shared setup changes and unlisted MEP mutations remain outside this release.
Existing four-plugin qualification is retained by source review for unchanged handlers and fresh installed Family checks. This is not completion of broad migration, performance or the Grand Refactor.
Checkpointed plans remain enabled; atomic plans remain excluded. Revit 2026 starter coverage retains the qualified Mark-tag scope.
Installed Autodesk prerequisites on this PC; Windows user environment storage simulated. No second-PC claim.
